facts.name: William Wallace
facts.assignment: All Okeechobee County Court cases; assistance with felony drug court, mental health, veterans, juvenile delinquency/detention, truancy and probate; county Children’s Services Council member.

mailing_address: Okeechobee County Judicial Center, Suite 368, Courtroom D

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Email JA with case number/name/subject; copy all parties unless ex parte authorized. Telephone permitted; no text messages.
procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Request hearing through JA; immediately file/serve notice with ADA notice and any Zoom credentials from JA. Notify JA and file/serve cancellation immediately.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: Hearing materials due two business days before hearing. No separate general conferral requirement identified in this guide; consult applicable rules.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Email Word and/or PDF, share with parties and identify agreement or disagreement; within ten days after hearing unless otherwise directed. Mail/hand delivery for persons excused from email; packages require conforming copies and stamped addressed envelopes.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: PDF or 8.5-by-11-inch paper, emailed/mailed/hand delivered and shared with parties; guide says two days before hearing/trial, separately from two-business-day hearing-material rule.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Request by motion; guide says within two days prior to hearing. Zoom credentials from JA; pretrial conferences in person.

conflicts: Profile names William Wallace and Karen Harris; PDF uses William J. Wallace and Karen M. Harris. Both preserved without asserting a personnel change.
Guide distinguishes two business days for hearing materials from two days for courtesy copies. Remote-request wording is within two days prior; no inferred correction.
